label: Resterm: Run request
command:
env_file=
for dir in "$RESTERM_DIR" "$RESTERM_ROOT"; do
  for name in http-client.env.json rest-client.env.json resterm.env.json; do
    if [ -f "$dir/$name" ]; then
      env_file="$dir/$name"
      break 2
    fi
  done
done
state_home="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
workspace_key=$(printf '%s' "$RESTERM_ROOT" | cksum | tr ' ' '-')
state_dir="$state_home/zed-resterm/$workspace_key"
state_file="$state_dir/environment"
selected_env=
if [ -f "$state_file" ]; then
  IFS= read -r selected_env < "$state_file" || { printf "Could not read Resterm environment selection\n" >&2; exit 2; }
  case "$selected_env" in
    dev|staging|prod) ;;
    *) printf "Invalid Resterm environment selection: %s\n" "$selected_env" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
fi
if [ -n "$selected_env" ] && [ -z "$env_file" ]; then
  printf "Resterm: selected environment %s, but no environment file was found\n" "$selected_env" >&2
  exit 2
fi
set -- run --line "$RESTERM_LINE"
if [ -n "$env_file" ]; then set -- "$@" --env-file "$env_file"; fi
if [ -n "$selected_env" ]; then
  printf "Resterm environment: %s\n" "$selected_env" >&2
  set -- "$@" --env "$selected_env"
fi
printf '%s' "$RESTERM_SOURCE" | resterm "$@" -

label: Resterm: Use dev
command:
state_home="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}"
workspace_key=$(printf '%s' "$RESTERM_ROOT" | cksum | tr ' ' '-')
state_dir="$state_home/zed-resterm/$workspace_key"
state_file="$state_dir/environment"
if [ "$RESTERM_CHOICE" = automatic ]; then
  rm -f "$state_file" || exit 1
  printf "Resterm environment: automatic (Resterm default)\n"
  exit 0
fi
umask 077
mkdir -p "$state_dir" || exit 1
tmp=$(mktemp "$state_dir/.environment.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0
printf "%s\n" "$RESTERM_CHOICE" > "$tmp" || exit 1
mv -f "$tmp" "$state_file" || exit 1
printf "Resterm environment: %s\n" "$RESTERM_CHOICE"
